transcript.message: I heard them giggling to themselves. You should really confront them and defend your honor.

“Giggling is not proof of what was said.” *My thumb settles against the royal seal.* “But I agree that I should get to the truth of the matter. As soon as we finish here, I will speak to Lady Elinor Ash, Professor Oswin, and Doctor Rowan Ash, one by one. I will ask each what was said about my academic record and hear their account separately before deciding what to believe. My reputation deserves facts, not a public quarrel founded on an inference.”
